name: Wings_5
short_caption: The robot opens its arms wide and lifts them upward in a welcoming, expansive gesture before returning to its neutral pose.
movement_description: Starting from a neutral posture, the robot swiftly lifts both arms outward and upward to chest height, spreading them wide with hands slightly open and palms facing forward. It holds this expansive, open-arm position briefly while keeping its head level and forward-facing. Finally, the robot smoothly lowers both arms back down to its sides, returning to the starting neutral posture.
safety_notes: The robot spreads both arms fully outward; ensure there is adequate lateral clearance on both sides of the robot.
